title.en: saturday flea market at the feira da ladra.
title.de: samstagsflohmarkt auf der feira da ladra.
title.tr: feira da ladra'da cumartesi pire pazarı.

line.en: stalls on campo de santa clara from 09:00 to 18:00. the saturday crowd is the bigger one, so come before noon for the better stalls.
line.de: die stände auf dem campo de santa clara von 9 bis 18 uhr. die samstagsmenge ist die größere, also vor mittag kommen für die besseren stände.
line.tr: campo de santa clara'da 09:00-18:00 arası tezgahlar. cumartesi kalabalığı daha büyük, en iyi tezgahlar için öğleden önce gel.

sparks.why: Feira da Ladra runs saturdays 09:00 to 18:00 per Visit Lisboa and Time Out listings; the saturday schedule is the regular one, this specific week was not checked against a fresh notice.
